content: For a small financial dashboard, Recharts v3 (SVG-based, ~150kB, 2.4M weekly downloads, composable React API) is the lighter, more flexible choice; Tremor is a Recharts-based pre-styled dashboard kit (~200kB) that pairs with shadcn/ui aesthetics but reduces chart-type/customization flexibility. Recommendation: Recharts directly for full control at small bundle cost, since dataset sizes (monthly cash flow) are small so its SVG-per-point performance ceiling is irrelevant.
